name: Emirates Skywards Premium World Elite Mastercard

localized_names.en: Emirates Skywards Premium World Elite Mastercard

apr.notes: 0% introductory APR for 12 billing cycles on balance transfers within 45 days of account opening, then 19.49% to 29.49%. Cash advance APR 29.74% variable. Minimum monthly interest charge $1.00. Balance transfer fee 5% (min $5). Cash advance fee 5% (min $10).

base_rate.description: Earn 1 Skywards Mile on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Skywards Miles don't expire while your account is open. No limit to the number of Skywards Miles you can earn. NEW: Earn 1 Tier Mile per 4 base Skywards Miles earned. Earn 10,000 anniversary bonus Skywards Miles annually after spending $30,000 on purchases each cardmembership year.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 70,000 bonus Skywards Miles after spending $3,000 on purchases in the first 90 days. Plus enjoy Emirates Skywards Gold tier membership during your first year.

benefits.title: Emirates Skywards Gold Tier Membership
benefits.description: Enjoy Emirates Skywards Gold tier membership during your first year, and retain your tier status by spending $40,000 each cardmembership year.

benefits.title: 10,000 Anniversary Bonus Skywards Miles
benefits.description: Earn 10,000 anniversary bonus Skywards Miles after spending $30,000 on purchases each cardmembership year.

benefits.title: Earn 1 Tier Mile per 4 Base Skywards Miles
benefits.description: NEW! Earn 1 Tier Mile per 4 base Skywards Miles earned.

benefits.title: Cash + Miles Special Rate
benefits.description: NEW! Enjoy a special rate when using your Emirates Skywards Mastercard to book flights on emirates.com and the Emirates App using Cash + Miles.

benefits.title: Priority Pass™ Select Lounge Access
benefits.description: Priority Pass Select lounge access provides unlimited access to over 1,200 lounges worldwide for the primary cardmember and their guest(s).

benefits.title: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Application Fee Credit
benefits.description: Receive an automatic statement credit for the cost of one Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee every five years – up to $120.

benefits.title: Skywards Miles Don't Expire
benefits.description: The Skywards Miles you earn will not expire as long as your account remains open.

benefits.title: No Limit on Skywards Miles
benefits.description: There is no limit to the number of Skywards Miles you can earn.

benefits.title: 25% Savings When You Buy or Gift Miles
benefits.description: Receive a 25% savings when you Buy Skywards Miles for yourself or Gift Miles.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

benefits.title: Complimentary FICO® Credit Score
benefits.description: Complimentary online access to your FICO® Credit Score. Keep an eye on your credit score and get alerts when we learn that your score has changed.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: You're not responsible for charges you did not authorize.

benefits.title: Introductory APR on Balance Transfers
benefits.description: 0% intro APR for 12 months on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. After that, a variable APR will apply, 19.49% to 29.49%.

lounge_access.notes: Priority Pass Select — unlimited access to over 1,200 lounges worldwide for primary cardmember and guest(s)
